card.name: End of pitavastatin drug name
card.fires_on: The final piece "atin" completing the statin name pitavastatin in drug labels. Weaker on the ending of similar drug names such as indapamide.

modes.label: Pitavastatin ending
modes.description: The closing piece "atin" that finishes the name pitavastatin, in dosing, warning and interaction text.
modes.example: The maximum recommended dose of pitavast<<atin>> tablets is 4 mg once daily .
